note: Every signal the live monitor can observe -> its visual mapping (docs/ui-design.md 6). scripts/check_docs.py requires an entry for every L0 kind (ga 0.6 emitted + l0-telemetry catalog) and every file/derived signal of docs/visualization.md screen live_monitor; signals ga 0.6 emits must have a real visual, a reduced-motion alternative and a non-color cue. Words are only build, wait, talk, test, done.

signals.visual: figure emerges at the edge of the stage and takes its place
signals.motion: scale 0->1, slow (400 ms), then settles into the layout
signals.reduced_motion: appears at full size, fades in 120 ms
signals.not_color_only: shape appears (presence), not a color change

signals.visual: figure leaves for the rest rim; outcome done leaves a solid dot, failed a broken-outline dot, idle fades without a mark
signals.reduced_motion: jumps to rim, outline style shows outcome
signals.not_color_only: outcome told by mark shape: solid dot / broken outline / no mark

signals.visual: a small child tile buds off the proposer's tile and joins the waiting shelf
signals.motion: bud splits off (base), floats up to the shelf
signals.reduced_motion: child tile appears on the shelf
signals.not_color_only: new tile shape with a thin link to its parent tile

signals.visual: a bud appears and dissolves, leaving a dotted outline for a moment
signals.reduced_motion: dotted outline shown 1 s, no motion

signals.visual: the tile cracks in two and slides to the side shelf
signals.reduced_motion: tile shown split on the side shelf
signals.not_color_only: split shape + position on side shelf

signals.visual: the figure exhales: one ring expands from it; the figure grows a step (area ~ sqrt(tokens of this item)); its fuel arc advances
signals.motion: ring expands and fades (slow); size eases (base)
signals.reduced_motion: ring drawn once at final size, no expansion; size changes instantly
signals.not_color_only: ring + size + arc length, all lightness-independent
signals.hover: model, turns, tokens in/out/cache, cost (CLI), duration

signals.visual: a pulse of light travels along the curve from sender to receiver; pulse size ~ log(bytes); line weight = pi
signals.motion: travel along the edge (~800 ms, eased)
signals.reduced_motion: edge highlighted (thicker) for 1 s, no travel
signals.not_color_only: pulse is a moving shape; edge weight, not color, carries pi

signals.visual: the receiver absorbs the pulse: a short ring flash on its outline
figure starts its working glow (build)
signals.motion: breathing glow whose tempo rises with elapsed time
signals.reduced_motion: steady glow + small elapsed tick marks

signals.visual: same exhale ring as run.end
a small dot orbits the figure (the work goes on)
figure starts its working glow
fuel arcs update
figure inhales: glow brightens briefly
small exhale ring and fuel arc advance
figure outline flickers jagged once
a spark leaves the figure to its tool orbit
the spark returns into the figure
a small dot drops into the figure from above
a dot leaves the figure and fades
figure outline turns dashed and its glow pauses
same as provider.rate_limit while the window lasts
figure squeezes briefly (its memory was compacted)
a spark leaves toward the stage edge (an action goes out)
the spark returns: solid if ok, jagged if error
none
signals.reason: limits are static config; shown only in hover detail

signals.visual: none
signals.reason: status text is not meaningful to a lay viewer; hover detail only

signals.visual: none
signals.reason: end of a stream; the figure simply stops its activity marks

signals.visual: none
signals.reason: environment probing has no meaning on the stage

signals.visual: a tile appears on the waiting shelf (top band)
the tile flies from the shelf into the figure's hands
signals.not_color_only: position change + tile attached to figure

signals.visual: the tile settles on the done shelf (bottom band) and fills in
the tile cracks and slides to the side shelf
figure dims and breathes slowly
figure starts to fade toward the rim
ambient light sweeps once across the stage (the beat of the pool)
signals.not_color_only: n/a (ambient only, never the only cue)

signals.visual: waiting on a peer: figure dims and a thin taut tether reaches toward the awaited figure
a dot orbits the figure (continuing a job)
verified: the ring around the figure closes into a full circle; failed: the ring breaks with a jagged gap; needs_judgement: an open ring with a gap; budget: the ring stops with a flat cap
signals.not_color_only: closed / jagged / open / flat-capped ring shapes

signals.visual: the line between two figures thickens or thins (1-6 px) and pulls them closer or apart
fine particles stir inside the figure: the only sign of work inside a turn in ga 0.6 (running, elapsed)
fuel arcs and the horizon line (total use vs budget) update

signals.source: events per minute over all sources
signals.visual: ambient particle speed and sweep tempo
figures drift closer, lines brighten, pulses overlap into a shared rhythm

signals.source: no signal for 120 s while tiles wait or figures are live
signals.visual: the whole stage slows and dims; one small word appears

signals.source: budget use >= 80 %, or >= 2 failed tiles, or a waiting chain >= 3
signals.visual: heartbeat quickens, warm rim light at the horizon, tick marks on the fuel arcs

signals.source: queue empty, nothing live, >= 1 tile done
signals.visual: everything settles in a line, one calm sweep of light
